data.one_liner: A scrollable list where items are grouped into sections with sticky headers.
data.what_it_does: Renders a list of items divided into groups with customizable headers. Sticky headers stay pinned at the top while scrolling through their respective group, and it supports programmatic scrolling via a custom controller.
use_when: You need a chat-like interface with grouped messages.
You want section headers that stick to the top of the list during scroll.
You need to programmatically scroll to specific indexes or elements within a grouped list.
avoid_when: You do not need programmatic scrolling or sticky headers, where standard ListView or GroupedList would suffice.
strengths: Built-in sticky header support with floating and background color options.
Supports programmatic scrolling and jumping via a specialized controller.
Easy setup for chat interfaces by reversing the list and order.
weaknesses: Relies on scrollable_positioned_list, which may have different performance characteristics than standard Flutter lists.
data.minimal_example:
StickyGroupedListView<dynamic, String>(
  elements: _elements,
  groupBy: (dynamic element) => element['group'],
  groupSeparatorBuilder: (dynamic element) => Text(element['group']),
  itemBuilder: (context, dynamic element) => Text(element['name']),
)
